title: Failing CIA polygraphs because he knew too much

tellings.quote:
CIA got so paranoid at one point got so
paranoid. I couldn't pass a polygraph
anymore

plain: A former officer of the CIA, the US spy agency, named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, says the agency became so suspicious at one point that he could no longer pass a polygraph, a lie detector test. He links this to what he knew, and tells it as a sign of how strange his career became.
